text.ko: 업종 내 매우 약함. 약점: 자기자본이익률(ROE) 6.6%.
text.en: Very weak within its sector. Weakness: Return on equity 6.6%.

text.en: Strong within its sector. Strength: Revenue growth consistency 100%. Weakness: 3-yr EPS growth (annual) 3.4%.

text.en: About average for its sector. Strength: Credit loss allowance ratio 0.9%. Weakness: Intangibles and goodwill share of assets 40.6%.

text.ko: 업종 내 매우 약함. 약점: PEG(성장 대비 PER) 11.08x.
text.en: Very weak within its sector. Weakness: PEG ratio 11.08x.

text.ko: 현재 경제 환경이 이 업종에 유리한 편이에요. 주요 요인: 금리 상승 국면 (유리).
text.en: The current economy tends to favor this sector. Main factor: rising rates (helps).
